description: This file contains source code for a React component-based UI related to mask management in a chat application, including mask editing, listing, importing/exporting, and interaction handling.

classes.name: MaskAvatar
classes.description: Component that displays a user's avatar, defaulting to a model avatar if not a custom mask avatar.

classes.name: MaskConfig
classes.description: Component for viewing and editing mask properties such as avatar, name, context hiding, sharing options, and model configuration.

classes.name: ContextPromptItem
classes.description: Component representing a single prompt in the context list, with editing and delete capabilities.

classes.name: ContextPrompts
classes.description: Component managing the list of contextual chat messages with drag-and-drop reordering.

classes.name: MaskPage
classes.description: Main component providing UI for listing, searching, creating, exporting, importing, and editing masks in the application.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Helper function to reorder list items based on drag-and-drop indices.

methods.name: MaskAvatar
methods.description: Renders avatar image based on whether it's a default mask or custom.

methods.name: MaskConfig
methods.description: Provides UI for configuring mask details; handles avatar, name, context visibility, sharing, and model settings.

methods.name: ContextPromptItem
methods.description: A single prompt row allowing editing role and content, plus deletion.

methods.name: ContextPrompts
methods.description: Manages a list of chat message prompts with drag-and-drop reordering and insertions.

methods.name: MaskPage
methods.description: Orchestrates the mask management interface including search, filter, create, import/export, and modal editing.
